definition: [ חַדּוּד ] adjective sharpened, sharp, pointed , only construct, with superlative sense = substantive: תַּחְתָּיו חַדּוּדֵי חָ֑רֶשׁ Job 41:22 beneath him the sharpest of potsherds , of scales of crocodile, compare Di VB .

[חַדּוּד] adjective sharpened, sharp, pointed, only construct, with superlative sense = substantive: תַּחְתָּיו חַדּוּדֵי חָ֑רֶשׁ Job 41:22 beneath him the sharpest of potsherds, of scales of crocodile, compare Di VB.
